contextSummary.title: Context Summary
contextSummary.description: A short summary of the conversation or situation for the human who picks up the case.

orderId.title: Order Id
orderId.description: The Salesforce record Id of the order this escalation concerns.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this is being escalated to a human, in a few words. Becomes the case subject.

returnRequestId.title: Return Request Id
returnRequestId.description: The Id of an existing return request to mark Escalated and link to this case. Leave blank if not about a specific return request.
